name: minimp3
description: Vendored minimp3 (lieff/minimp3), a small single-header MP3 decoder. CC0 / public domain. Used by the device music player (src/sfx/music) for MP3 playback from SD /music.

upstream.vendoredFrom: upstream master @ 2022-06-25; the base minimp3.h matched upstream blob 9fbd4d2cc50c06cc3e63dcafdd506dc6512b2103 byte-for-byte at vendor time
upstream.localPatches: CUM-222: added mp3dec_scratch_size() and mp3dec_decode_frame_ex() so the ~15 KB decode scratch can be caller-provided (PSRAM) instead of on the calling task's stack. mp3dec_decode_frame() is preserved byte-identical, so any other caller is unchanged.
